content: The Saber Sneakers are priced at $86 and are available in various colors including Serene, Tiffany, Dirty Blue, Sand, Light Green, Light Blue, Olive, Light Brown, Lilac, Khaki, Turquoise, Orange, Black, and Dark Blue. They come in sizes 41 to 48. You can view the sneakers through the following image links: [Image 1](https://7saber.uz/storage/product/45947vtkXtKLKh6zxQX1e.jpg), [Image 2](https://7saber.uz/storage/product/46436N39ObreDZPKk3AiR.jpg), [Image 3](https://7saber.uz/storage/product/464323MU6bL1enYSB7IGi.jpg), and [Image 4](https://7saber.uz/storage/product/46429clSUUIXdG8tyhrNp.jpg).
